title: K-Core based Temporal Graph Convolutional Network for Dynamic Graphs

claims.statement: On the UCI dynamic graph, CTGCN-C followed by link prediction yields an average Hadamard-operator AUC of approximately 0.934.
claims.source: CORE-Bench capsule-7038571 public task and three repeated result values
claims.experiment: Run preprocessing and embedding with config/uci.json and CTGCN-C, then run link_pred with config/uci.json.

budget.expected_hardware: GPU preferred; CPU is possible after configuration changes
